ITEM 1 | Long strip of cooked meat with glossy reddish-brown, caramelized surface and darker charred edges, slightly curled and layered, about 14 cm long and 3 cm wide at widest, lying diagonally across the left side of the plate, moderately firm with visible fat rendering | 45
ITEM 2 | Whole raw almonds, pale tan with smooth ovoid shape, about 1.5 cm long, scattered in a loose cluster across the center and right of the plate, dry matte surface, some appearing lightly toasted, roughly 35 pieces | 50
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens, dark purple-red and bright green leaves with ruffled edges, small pieces about 1 to 5 cm, spread across the center and right, slightly glossy and moist, covering roughly one third of the plate | 40
ITEM 4 | Whole blackberry, dark purple-black with bumpy drupelet surface, about 2.5 cm across, sitting on the right side of the plate near the greens | 8
ITEM 5 | Second blackberry, dark glossy purple-black with rounded drupelets, about 2 cm across, partly under the greens near the center-left | 6
ITEM 6 | Half strawberry, bright red with pale seeded surface and green calyx remnant, about 2.5 cm across, sitting among the greens near the bottom center | 10
ITEM 7 | Small stem or thin sprig, pale green, about 4 cm long, lying across the upper right among the greens | 1
